arxiv-2305-11584.title: Dynamic Regularized Sharpness Aware Minimization in Federated Learning: Approaching Global Consistency and Smooth Landscape
arxiv-2305-11584.creator: Yan Sun, Li Shen, Shixiang Chen, Liang Ding, Dacheng Tao
arxiv-2305-11584.description: Abstract In federated learning (FL), a cluster of local clients are chaired under the coordination of the global server and cooperatively train one model with privacy protection. Due to the multiple local updates and the isolated non-iid dataset, clients are prone to overfit into their own optima, which extremely deviates from the global objective and significantly undermines the performance.

arxiv-2308-09957.title: Data-to-text Generation for Severely Under-Resourced Languages with GPT-3.5: A Bit of Help Needed from Google Translate
arxiv-2308-09957.creator: Michela Lorandi, Anya Belz
arxiv-2308-09957.description: Abstract LLMs like GPT are great at tasks involving English which dominates in their training data. In this paper, we look at how they cope with tasks involving languages that are severely under-represented in their training data, in the context of data-to-text generation for Irish, Maltese, Welsh and Breton.

arxiv-2312-15386.title: Hyperspectral shadow removal with Iterative Logistic Regression and latent Parametric Linear Combination of Gaussians
arxiv-2312-15386.creator: Core Francisco Park, Maya Nasr, Manuel Pérez-Carrasco, Eleanor Walker, Douglas Finkbeiner, Cecilia Garraffo
arxiv-2312-15386.description: Abstract Shadow detection and removal is a challenging problem in the analysis of hyperspectral images. Yet, this step is crucial for analyzing data for remote sensing applications like methane detection. In this work, we develop a shadow detection and removal method only based on the spectrum of each pixel and the overall distribution of spectral values.

arxiv-2402-04230.title: Medium Resolution 0.97-5.3 μ \mu m spectra of Very Young Benchmark Brown Dwarfs with NIRSpec onboard the James Webb Space Telescope Facilities: JWST (NIRSpec) astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 )
arxiv-2402-04230.creator: Elena Manjavacas, Pascal Tremblin, Stephan Birkmann, Jeff Valenti, Catarina Alves de Oliveira, Tracy L. Beck, G. Giardino, N. Lützgendorf, B. J. Rauscher, M. Sirianni
arxiv-2402-04230.description: Abstract Spectra of young benchmark brown dwarfs with well-known ages are vital to characterize other brown dwarfs, for which ages are in general not known. These spectra are also crucial to test atmospheric models which have the potential to provide detailed information about the atmospheres of these objects.

arxiv-2408-00203.title: OmniParser for Pure Vision Based GUI Agent
arxiv-2408-00203.creator: Yadong Lu, Jianwei Yang, Yelong Shen, Ahmed Awadallah
arxiv-2408-00203.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yadong Lu, Jianwei Yang, Yelong Shen, Ahmed Awadallah. The recent success of large vision language models shows great potential in driving the agent system operating on user interfaces. However, we argue that the power multimodal models like GPT-4V as a general agent on multiple operating systems across different applications is largely underestimated due to the lack of a robust screen parsing technique capable of: 1) reliably identifying interactable icons within the user interface, and 2) understanding the semantics of various elements in a screenshot

arxiv-2409-07351.title: Federated Impression for Learning with Distributed Heterogeneous Data
arxiv-2409-07351.creator: Atrin Arya, Sana Ayromlou ∗, Armin Saadat, Purang Abolmaesumi, Xiaoxiao Li
arxiv-2409-07351.description: Abstract Standard deep learning-based classification approaches may not always be practical in real-world clinical applications, as they require a centralized collection of all samples. Federated learning (FL) provides a paradigm that can learn from distributed datasets across clients without requiring them to share data, which can help mitigate privacy and data ownership issues.

arxiv-2501-02443.title: On the Klein-Gordon scalar field oscillators in a spacetime with spiral-like dislocations in external magnetic fields
arxiv-2501-02443.creator: Omar Mustafa, Abdullah Guvendi
arxiv-2501-02443.description: Abstract We investigate the effects of two types of spiral dislocation (the distortion of the radial line, labeled as spiral dislocation I, and the distortion of a circle, labeled as spiral dislocation II) on the relativistic dynamics of the Klein-Gordon (KG) oscillator fields, both in the presence and absence of external magnetic fields.

arxiv-2501-13298.title: Collaborative Coded Caching for Partially Connected Networks
arxiv-2501-13298.creator: Kagan Akcay 1 , Eleftherios Lampiris 1 , MohammadJavad Salehi 2 , and Giuseppe Caire 1
arxiv-2501-13298.description: Abstract Coded caching leverages the differences in user cache memories to achieve gains that scale with the total cache size, alleviating network congestion due to high-quality content requests. Additionally, distributing transmitters over a wide area can mitigate the adverse effects of path loss.

arxiv-2507-17313.title: Scattering Hawking Radiation
arxiv-2507-17313.creator: Peng Cheng
arxiv-2507-17313.description: Abstract We analyze the physical consequences of scattering Hawking radiation emitted in the vicinity of the horizon of a Schwarzschild black hole. The Hawking radiation from the horizon becomes soft at a large distance away from the horizon due to the gravitational redshift, and the above process is exactly the soft theorem in curved spacetime.

arxiv-2509-02854.title: Characters and The Generation of Sylow 3-subgroups For Almost Simple Groups Thanks: This work was partially supported by the U.S. National Science Foundation, Award No. DMS-2439897
arxiv-2509-02854.creator: Eden Ketchum
arxiv-2509-02854.description: Abstract . Given an almost simple group A A , we algorithmically show that the character table of A A determines whether or not the Sylow 3-subgroups of A A are 2-generated. We show this property is equivalent to a condition on involving Galois action on characters in the principal block. This would be a consequence of the Alperin-McKay-Navarro conjecture.

Although predicting the early stage of breast cancer before metastasis can increase the survival rate, breast cancer is often discovered or...

pmc-10535604.title: In Vitro and In Vivo Anti-Inflammatory Effects of Cannabidiol Isolated from Novel Hemp (Cannabis sativa L.) Cultivar Pink Pepper
pmc-10535604.creator: Jong-Hui Kim, Min Hong, Joon-Hee Han, Byeong Ryeol Ryu, Young Seok Lim, Jung Dae Lim, Chang Hyeug Kim, Soo-Ung Lee, Tae-Hyung Kwon, Junho Kim
pmc-10535604.description: Cannabis sativa L. contains more than 80 cannabinoids, among which cannabidiol (CBD) is the main neuroactive component. We aimed to investigate the anti-inflammatory efficacy of CBD in vitro and in vivo isolated from “Pink pepper”, a novel hemp cultivar, by repeating the method of selecting and cultivating individuals with the highest CBD content.

pmc-10738270.title: SOCIAL ISOLATION AND HOSPITALIZATION IN A NATIONAL SAMPLE OF COMMUNITY-DWELLING OLDER ADULTS BY DEMENTIA STATUS
pmc-10738270.creator: Mary Louise Pomeroy, Katherine Ornstein, Gilbert Gimm, Thomas Cudjoe
pmc-10738270.description: Social isolation poses risks for poor health, yet its impact on hospitalization for persons with dementia is unknown. Dementia may result in reduced social contact that increases the risk of hospitalization. This observational cohort study examined longitudinal associations between social isolation and hospitalization among a nationally-representative sample of community-dwelling older adults with and without dementia.

pmc-10745537.title: The Role of Aspartate Aminotransferase-to-Lymphocyte Ratio Index (ALRI) in Predicting Mortality in SARS-CoV-2 Infection
pmc-10745537.creator: José Manuel Reyes-Ruiz, Omar García-Hernández, Gustavo Martínez-Mier, Juan Fidel Osuna-Ramos, Luis Adrián De Jesús-González, Carlos Noe Farfan-Morales, Selvin Noé Palacios-Rápalo, Carlos Daniel Cordero-Rivera, Tatiana Ordoñez-Rodríguez, Rosa María del Ángel, Shengxi Chen, Fabio Zicker, Josep M Llibr
pmc-10745537.description: COVID-19 has a mortality rate exceeding 5.4 million worldwide. The early identification of patients at a high risk of mortality is essential to save their lives. The AST-to-lymphocyte ratio index (ALRI) is a novel biomarker of survival in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma, an organ susceptible to SARS-CoV-2 infection.

pmc-11339320.title: Effect of Obesity on the Use of Antiarrhythmics in Adults With Atrial Fibrillation: A Narrative Review
pmc-11339320.creator: Fahad Shaikh, Rochelle Wynne, Ronald L. Castelino, Patricia M. Davidson, Sally C. Inglis, Caleb Ferguson
pmc-11339320.description: BackgroundAtrial fibrillation (AF) and obesity coexist in approximately 37.6 million and 650 million people globally, respectively. The anatomical and physiological changes in individuals with obesity may influence the pharmacokinetic properties of drugs.AimThis review aimed to describe the evidence of the effect of obesity on the pharmacokinetics of antiarrhythmics in people with AF.MethodsThree databases were searched from inception to June 2023.

pmc-11663870.title: The role of ferroptosis-related non-coding RNA in liver fibrosis
pmc-11663870.creator: Guozhu Zhang, Kejia Wu, Xiaobo Jiang, Yuan Gao, Dong Ding, Hao Wang, Chongyuan Yu, Xiaozhong Wang, Naixin Jia, Li Zhu
pmc-11663870.description: Liver fibrosis represents a reversible pathophysiological process, caused by chronic inflammation stemming from hepatocyte damage. It delineates the initial stage in the progression of chronic liver disease. This pathological progression is characterized by the excessive accumulation of the extracellular matrix (ECM), which leads to significant structural disruption and ultimately impairs liver function.

pmc-12649657.title: Antimicrobial Stewardship Program Implementation, Perceptions, and Barriers in Zambia: A Cross-Sectional Study Among Healthcare Professionals
pmc-12649657.creator: Steward Mudenda, Joseph Yamweka Chizimu, Victor Daka, Jimmy Hangoma, Kelvin Mwangilwa, Priscilla Gardner, Chikwanda Chileshe, Taona Sinyawa, Zoran Muhimba, Charles Chileshe, Sandra Diana Mwadetsa, Shikanga O-Tipo, Duncan Chanda, Maisa Kasanga, Geoffrey Mainda, Webrod Mufwambi, Samson Mukale, Andrew
pmc-12649657.description: Background/Objectives: Antimicrobial stewardship programs (ASPs) play a vital role in combating antimicrobial resistance (AMR). However, their implementation in Zambia remains variable despite some notable progress. This study assessed healthcare professionals’ awareness of the Multisectoral National Action Plan (NAP) on AMR, alongside their perceptions, barriers, and implementation practices related to ASPs.

pmc-12660722.title: m6A regulators-based gene expression pattern is associated with immune microenvironment characteristics in hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-12660722.creator: Wenjuan Wang, Erxiong Wang, Kunqiao Hong, Wei Jiang, Banlai Ruan, Jie Liu, Jinping Tian, Feng Ding, Qiuyun Guo, Qianshan Ding
pmc-12660722.description: To evaluate the relationship between N6-methyladenosine (m6A) modification-related genes and the immune microenvironment characteristics of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), and to evaluate the potential of targeting m6A regulators to sensitize HCC cells to immunotherapy. RNA sequencing data and clinicopathologic data of HCC patients were obtained from TCGA and ICGC database.

pmc-13348528.title: Network based associations between peer rejection and adolescent depression: evidence from general population and clinical samples
pmc-13348528.creator: Chunyan Lu, Duanwei Wang, Yu Cao, Yufei Hu, Ying Yang, Huijing Sun, Xiuling Tian, Linghua Kong, Kangcheng Wang
pmc-13348528.description: BackgroundPeer rejection is a significant risk factor for adolescent depression, but most studies have examined their associations treating them as unitary constructs. Considering their conceptional complexity, our study employs network analysis to examine the associations between different types of peer rejection and specific depressive symptoms at the dimension level and their changes from the general population to clinical samples.

pmc-13613732.title: Albumin-based nutritional-inflammatory indices and prognosis in critically ill patients with acute myocardial infarction: a MIMIC-IV cohort study
pmc-13613732.creator: Huijian Wang, Xiaoli Wen, Yijun Huang, Huabin He
pmc-13613732.description: ObjectiveThis study investigated the associations between 12 albumin-based nutritional–inflammatory indices and adverse outcomes in critically ill patients with acute myocardial infarction and compared their prognostic performance.MethodsA retrospective cohort study was conducted using the MIMIC-IV database, which includes data from 2,255 critically ill AMI patients.
